question: List the names of customers in Pune.
expected_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE city = 'Pune'

question: Show product names from most to least expensive.
expected_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price DESC

question: How many customers are in each city?
expected_sql: SELECT city, count(*) FROM customers GROUP BY city

question: Which customers have ordered a laptop? Give their names.
expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Laptop'

question: What is the total revenue (price times quantity) per product category?
expected_sql: SELECT p.category, sum(p.price * o.quantity) FROM orders o JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id GROUP BY p.category

question: Which customer has spent the most in total? Give just the name.
expected_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN products p ON p.id = o.product_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY sum(p.price * o.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which customers have never placed an order? Give their names.
expected_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

question: How many orders were placed in June 2024?
expected_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-06-01' AND order_date < '2024-07-01'

question: Which cities have more than one customer?
expected_sql: SELECT city FROM customers GROUP BY city HAVING count(*) > 1

question: What is the average price of furniture products?
expected_sql: SELECT avg(price) FROM products WHERE category = 'furniture'

question: For each customer, show their name and the date of their first order.
expected_sql: SELECT c.name, min(o.order_date) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name
